reason: The studio's category union and write-allowlist had no way to express or display a `friction` kind, so valid writes were rejected and artifacts were invisible.
An existing coverage tool parses .tsx sources with the wrong ScriptKind, silently mis-counting assertions.
The ADR-NNNN placeholder token cannot distinguish a session's allocate-late marker from the corpus's generic any-ADR pattern, so a substitution cannot tell the two apart.
The build command writes to the launching session's presence row and flips it to done, an incorrect write by an existing verb.
Spawned builders ended their turn before the objective was reached, waiting for a notification that never comes, and needed a nudge to continue.
The launch path without the tsx loader boots successfully then 500s every API route with an error naming a workspace package rather than the missing loader.
No scaffolding step or mechanism exists for a new package inside the --real chain, and per-phase write fences leave no leaf able to create one.
A .strict() wire schema cannot express an additive producer field, so the record simply cannot carry the data and the fail-silent writer drops it.
A handed-down brief's negative existence premise, true when written, expired due to a concurrent sibling landing — no listed mode covers a premise that decays between authoring and consumption.
The coverage check ran but validated against a test title rather than the contract's clauses, so it read 7/7 while most clauses were unasserted.
The gate orders its ten-second claim check after typecheck and full test legs, a bad ordering that turns a trivial fix into a full re-run.
The mirror-conformance guard covers only one of the mirrored routes, so it checks part of the outcome and the rest drift unfenced.
No claim or mutex mechanism exists for the friction queue at all, so concurrent adjudicator seats cannot be refused or warned.
The check's V=0 ceiling is scoped per-repo rather than per-author, so an existing rung reds a session over a sibling's live edits.
An existing command leaves the house @path convention unresolved and performs a wholesale record-replacing write that destroys the prior verdict.
The install verb registers a hook by absolute path without verifying the host script exists and is post-flip, reporting a wall that enforces nothing.
Node/pnpm module and CJS-vs-ESM resolution keys off the script's own directory, so the documented incantation fails outside the workspace with errors naming neither cause.
The sheet artifact has no field tying a cell to the code state that produced it, so a two-variable comparison is indistinguishable from a one-variable one.
The renderer's fixed ordering puts the actionable parked section behind the entire increment log, making truncation silently hide it.
The build's AUTHOR_TEST turn budget was exhausted twice on a trivially isolatable unit, a bad budget in an existing command.
The probe ran but its stable-picture predicate measured only accretion, validating against the wrong condition and admitting visually changing frames.
The authoring session shipped a steering comparative that was checkable against artifacts already in the store and was never checked at authoring or consumption.
The lifecycle rule reads only the increment log, so chip-carried work is a record type the arc's completeness surface cannot see.
The check holds both facts but reports only the routine staleness signature, so its printed remedy is actively wrong for this case.
No mechanism exists to detect a semantic cross-ADR falsification of a prescribed build address, so neither the curator pass nor any gate rung can catch it.
A shell pipe holding stdout open defeats the detach and the harness timeout SIGTERMs the pipeline — the shell and tool platform are the cause.
The check ran but asserted against the branch diff rather than the promise it meant to fence, so it reported a broken promise where there was none and would pass while untrue.
No kind-agnostic or field-agnostic text search over the corpus exists, so the absence sweep simply cannot be performed.
The non-vacuity guard ran but counted opaque pixels, a quantity no prop change can move, so it passes over a picture missing its subject.
A Linux-CI temp-directory rmdir race in fixture teardown reds the job on branches whose code is untouched.
The harness hardcodes a steady-state 30s navigation budget with no override, a bad default that refuses on every cold worktree.
Bun is installed on the dev box but absent from the shell PATH, so the machine rather than the repository's code turns the gate red.
The live signing path passes the observe runner raw instead of memoized, so an existing command re-runs a deterministic suite once per leg.
An existing probe fails a correctly provisioned machine and its fix hint prescribes a retired, actively dangerous invariant.
The rerun comparison ran but tested git-unchanged as a proxy for nothing-was-fixed, issuing a confident wrong flake verdict for store-reading rungs.
The instrument's own correctness was never checked before its output was trusted and published; a typecheck of the measurement file was omitted until gate time.
The rung's closing message names only two remedies and omits the correct third, steering sessions toward tests that cannot pass or a disable comment freezing dead code.
The driver's committed-rung default builds a URL for an asset that is not in the repo, so the published reproduce command 404s on a fresh checkout.
A skip-capable rung fails to take its skip branch on a fresh worktree, so it reds regardless of branch content and is not in CI to reveal the mismatch.
A flag interaction re-arms a fence the documented --discharged-by exemption should clear, and the refusal prints a remedy that would mint a duplicate increment.
